purpose: Preserve the authored manufacture-scale normal and metallic/smoothness signals for benchmark-visible park furniture through Unity import so native-4K grazing and temporal evidence is not pre-degraded by block compression. This is implementation readiness only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without actual rendered evidence.

profiles.wetness: causal contact-zone aging; not globally glossy

importRequirements.reason: The weakest signals are the 0.028-0.055 mm metal/coating normals and narrow smoothness variation. Block compression can quantize normal direction and highlight width before 4K grazing review; mask alpha must remain intact because it carries canonical smoothness.

failureInjection: Set one protected normal or metallic/smoothness map to CompressedHQ and require failure.
Enable Crunch compression and require failure.
Enable a Standalone platform override and require failure.
Reduce maxTextureSize below 1024 or runtime dimensions below 1024x1024 and require failure.
Change filter mode to Bilinear or Point and require failure.
Reduce anisotropy below 8 and require failure.
Enable sRGB on either physical-data map and require failure.
Change a normal away from NormalMap and require failure.
Remove source alpha from a metallic/smoothness map and require failure before evidence rendering.
requiredRenderedEvidence: 3840x2160 oblique and grazing frames containing slide, bench, lamp or notice-board furniture
100% stainless slide crop proving travel-direction abrasion remains subtle and reflection-driven
100% timber/concrete crop proving physical-scale relief survives without block artifacts
temporal grazing sequence proving the preserved microdetail does not produce sparkle or shimmer
